name: concurrent-calls
description: Two calls to the same function, in flight at the same time, each waiting on something slow. They are siblings: neither is inside the other, and neither is a recursive call of the other. A tracer that keeps one stack of open frames will say otherwise, because both are open at once — and the trace it produces looks confident and is wrong. Python does not yet cover this case: its adapter has the same class of defect, reported differently, and the details are in docs/findings/python-async-frames.md.
